name: 8th World Congress of Cultural Psychiatry (next edition, unannounced)
description: The World Association of Cultural Psychiatry holds a World Congress of Cultural Psychiatry about every three years. The 7th congress was held jointly with the Pacific Rim College of Psychiatrists in Tokyo in September 2025; the 8th congress has not been announced on the association website as of September 2026.

sources.note: 7th World Congress, Tokyo, 25 to 28 September 2025, joint with PRCP; earlier congresses 2022 Rotterdam, 2018 New York, 2015 Puerto Vallarta; no 8th congress listed.
Report on the 2025 Tokyo joint congress attendance and programme.

notes: Three year cycle suggests 2028, but nothing is published.
